0022600002.text: Both the New York Knicks and Philadelphia 76ers open their 2026-27 seasons in this game at Madison Square Garden, and the Knicks are at home. Josh Hart is day-to-day with ankle soreness and is a game-time decision for New York, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti, who is out with a ruptured Achilles, and has Adem Bona, Anfernee Simons, Dean Wade, Dominick Barlow, Tacko Fall, and VJ Edgecombe listed as day-to-day. The teams split 2-2 in the 2025-26 regular season, the Knicks won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, and their most recent meeting was a 144-114 Knicks win in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Knicks a 55% chance to win.
